summary: Stanford University's John S. Knight Journalism Fellowships opened applications for the 2027-28 class on 14 October. The fellowships, based in Stanford, United States, are for journalism professionals with at least five years of professional experience; a college degree is not required. Applications close on 2 December 2026 at 13:00 Pacific time, and late applications or extensions are not accepted.
highlights: Five years of professional experience; student work and internships do not count.
A college degree is not required.
Apply with an online form, resume, work sample and contact details for three professional references.
Deadline: 2 December 2026, 13:00 (America/Los_Angeles); no late applications or extensions.
